proofBoundary.routeScopes: fixed server-owned policy arrays; requiredScopes never copied from client proof metadata
proofBoundary.binding: exact method + logical business path + canonical body digest + nonce + original mutable revalidator session context; path params fixed, no authority/query ambiguity
proofBoundary.query: Use A exact transport/query canonicalization. Until frozen, do not guess query in proof path or strip prefixes ad hoc; server always validates store/order/merchant ownership independently of filters.
proofBoundary.mount: Listed paths are existing service business paths. A Host adapter must bind actual external prefix to these exact routes using trusted routing context, not caller-provided strings.
proofBoundary.nonce: consume transactionally against the original revalidated object after scope/actor/store authority validation; replacement scope/session cannot be substituted
